scope: Patrick Arena at 2110 Cadboro Bay Road, Oak Bay, as it stood in 1925. Includes the timber rink hall, towered corners, and street entrance.

originalReview.notes: Three tall light-framed window groups on the curved timber entrance front, corner towers, street doors, repeated side lights and long shallow curved roof.

quallaSearch.notes: The search started with the one published Qualla photograph, identified by exact bytes as the original public-domain Dwyer image. The modern archive photographs of drawings and the atlas scan bearing further use restrictions were excluded.
